source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 22
statement: What CoCache keeps around a value in Redis is read alike by both versions' CoCache: the cross-version tests read and write every store through each version's own CoCache, the previous release loaded as published, and a case that holds only from a later release must still fail against an earlier baseline.
guards: compat:SideIsolationTest#the previous side runs the published release and the current side this build
compat:SideIsolationTest#neither version is visible to the test's own class loader
compat:BaselineTest#a case before its release must fail, and one that already holds says so
compat:SessionRecordCompatTest#each version reads the session the other wrote
